title: Context hint bar: keys for the selected row on a line above the status line, ctrl+d/u pane scroll, Questions tab count

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Split from S85 (owner, 2026-10-26, session a2bf7e0e). The 2026-10-22 UI review and the 2026-10-25 design review found that the only key hint on screen is "?help" in the sidebar header; the keys valid on the selected row are not shown. Owner decision: the hint bar is an extra line above the status line (not a replacement for it); it costs a body row at 80x24.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/view.go`: screen() adds the hint line above the status line; the status line keeps refreshed and pending.
- `internal/tui/keys.go`: a context ShortHelp built from the bindings that apply to the selected row, pane and view.
- `internal/tui/pane.go`: ctrl+d and ctrl+u scroll an open pane; the "started elsewhere, read-only; esc close pane" message moves to the hint line.
- `internal/tui/model.go`: the tab bar shows a count on Questions ("Questions 3").
- Tests: `internal/tui/tui_test.go`, `internal/tui/hint_test.go` (new).
- `testdata/golden/`: every view gains the hint line. Regenerate and review.
- `docs/dashboard.md`: Layout and key paragraphs.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestHintBarFollowsTheCursorRow: on a decision row the hint lists enter and the global keys; on an awaiting-approval engine row it adds a and x; on a paused row t; in an open pane esc, pgup/pgdown and ctrl+d/u; on the Roadmap l. It never lists a key the row refuses.
- TestHintBarSitsAboveTheStatusLine at 100x30 and 80x24, and the body loses exactly one row.
- TestCtrlDAndCtrlUScrollThePane; ctrl+u typed in an answer field still edits the field.
- TestQuestionsTabShowsItsCount.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Tests first. 2. Build the hint from the key bindings and the selected row's allowed actions (the same checks that refuse a key), not a hand-written list. 3. Move the pane's read-only message to the hint line. 4. ctrl+d/u pane scroll. 5. Questions tab count. 6. Docs and goldens. UI slice: UI pass per rule u10 (size M: separate row r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner reads the hint line in a live terminal at 100x30 and 80x24.
